description: Demolition of existing rear outrigger extensions; erection of a ground floor single storey rear extension; internal refurbishment; landscaping works to the front and rear; and, installation of new front boundary treatment.
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 18(a) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 as amended.

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

<p>All existing historic features including, but not limited to, chimney pieces, plasterwork, architraves, panelling, doors, and staircase balustrading shall remain undisturbed in their existing position and shall be fully protected during the course of works on site, unless specifically authorised otherwise on the drawings hereby approved.&nbsp; The development and works shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.</p><p>Reason: In order to protect the special interest of the listed building.</p>

<p>All new works and works of making good to the retained fabric, whether internal or external, shall be finished to match the original work with regard to the methods used and to material, dimensions, composition, form, colour, finish and profile unless otherwise specified in the details hereby approved.</p><p>Reason: In order to protect the special interest of the listed building.</p>

<p>The following shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA prior to the commencement of the relevant part of the works. The work shall be carried out in accordance with the details so approved, and shall be maintained as such thereafter.</p><p>a) Details and samples of all proposed external materials, fixtures and finishes, including stone, bricks, render and roofing slates;</p><p>b) Details of proposed new or altered internal and external plumbing, waste pipes and ventilation routes;</p><p>c) Details of all proposed vent and flue covers, including scale drawings showing the locations of the proposed vents, product specifications, size, material, colour and finish;</p><p>d) Details of proposed external rainwater and soil pipes;</p><p>e) Details of the proposed front wall and railing design, including fixings;</p><p>f) Details of proposed fireplaces; and</p><p>g) Details of all proposed external windows, rooflights, and doors, including the material, colour, finish, product information if available, and large-scale drawings of each window (elevations at 1:20, sections and details at 1:5, showing the window and its masonry surround/reveal) with full details of the proposed replacement windows.&nbsp;</p><p>Reason: In order to protect the special interest of the listed building.</p>
